text: Hiya, my 2 year old is 38.4 tonight. I think it's mostly her teeth, she's dribbling loads, chewing on everything she can get hold of and one cheek is bright red. She's also got a runny nose and sneezing a lot, possibly a bit of a cold on top. Her nappies are wet as usual so she's weeing fine. Just wondering whether teething can push her temp that high or if it's more likely the cold
